I will keep my land in the usual Quzhou pattern: winter wheat followed by summer maize. Around here that is still the main grain system, and Quzhou has long stabilized on this wheat-maize double-cropping pattern after irrigation improved; local reporting also shows the county still keeps very large wheat and maize areas, and recent Quzhou demonstration fields reached high yields with moderate nitrogen and controlled irrigation rather than heavy input. I am 57, so I will not chase complicated cash crops or management that depends on fast market timing. I will plant crops I know well, can mechanize, and can sell easily. I will use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed, keep fertilizer in a moderate range, save water because local water pressure is real, and do pest control at key stages instead of spraying too often. On wheat I will focus on seedbed quality, one base fertilizer plus a topdressing at jointing, 2 irrigations around jointing and booting/filling if the soil is dry, and 2 pesticide sprays centered on “one spray, three preventions” timing. After wheat harvest, I will direct-seed summer maize into the stubble to save time and moisture, use one main topdressing at the big flare stage, give 1 irrigation if summer rain is not enough, and spray twice if field scouting shows pressure. I am making this plan against local Quzhou/Hebei information here: Ministry of Agriculture report on Quzhou crop area and good-seed coverage: https://www.moa.gov.cn/xw/qg/202107/t20210720_6372348.htm ; Quzhou land-use/climate study noting about 556 mm rain, water stress, and wheat-maize dominance: https://www.resci.cn/CN/abstract/article/1007-7588/46556 ; China Agricultural University Quzhou station report with recent wheat-maize yields and nitrogen/water figures: https://qzsyz.cau.edu.cn/art/2024/10/8/art_46317_1039835.html ; Hebei 2025 summer maize technical guidance: https://nyncj.sjz.gov.cn/columns/86f1c43c-897d-4b4f-b83d-ee6e7fe11683/202506/24/2b46ecd8-58b6-4109-909d-f3d5c5efb908.html ; Hebei 2026 winter wheat spring irrigation guidance: https://www.agri.cn/zx/xxlb/hb/202603/t20260309_8817365.htm
